author: bact'
html: After less than two weeks of 2006 Thailand coup d'etat, …Around 20:00, 27 Sep 2006, local time, Midnight University website,http://www.midnightuniv.org/ [1], a Thai website that offers free access toacademic articles on Natural, Social, and Human Sciences, with a forumwhere discussions were largely towards current issues, politics or history,has been CLOSED down by the order of Ministry of ICT (under Council forDemocratic Reform, the military junta)** WITHOUT any notice or reason **Midnight University wants support from media, academics, and people like youto put pressure on the Ministry of ICT.Please send your message of support to [email hidden]@gmail.comAnd/or forward this message to friends of you who may like to support this act.Thank very so much for your support.[1]The website has been closed down.Below is a Google cache, showing its homepage before closing downhttp://209.85.129.104/search?q=cache:ZHtV_hrAhiMJ <a href="http://:www.midnightuniv.org/+midnight+university&hl=en&gl=de&ct=clnk&cd=1&client=firefox-a:www.midnightuniv.org/+midnight+university&hl=en&gl=de&ct=clnk&cd=1&client=firefox-a<br />—-http://www.nokkrob.org/index.php?&obj=forum.view(cat_id=nk_live,id=6)
